question: Through whose grace has the determination of the Kaula doctrine become known to the speaker?
premises: The speaker claims knowledge of the Kaula determination
The knowledge is attributed to another's grace
The addressed lord of Kaulas is the source of that grace
inference: The speaker knows the Kaula determination by the grace of the lord of Kaulas
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
